title: Mera Mera no Mi
facts: Appearance (One Piece Wiki): a round orange fruit, composed of many flame-shaped components with swirl patterns on each one, with a swirled stem on top
Logia-type Devil Fruit, English name Flame-Flame Fruit: the user can create, control and become fire
Logia intangibility: ordinary punches and bullets pass through the user (Haki can hit, not mentioned in this script)
Hiken (Fire Fist): a column of flame; Ace destroyed five Baroque Works ships with one Hiken in the Alabasta arc
Hotarubi Hidaruma (Fire Flies): small firefly-like flames float around the target, then ignite on it all at once
Dai Enkai Entei (Flame Emperor): a giant sun-like fireball, Ace's strongest attack shown
When a user dies, the Devil Fruit power reappears in a nearby fruit; after Ace died at Marineford, the Mera Mera no Mi was the Corrida Colosseum prize, and Sabo won it
'This fire never goes out' and 'never pay a heating bill' are figurative and a joke, not fruit rules
